Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely categorizes confinement engineering for alloying-type sodium-ion battery anodes into self-confinement and extrinsic confinement, clarifying micro/nano-scale structure-regulation mechanisms. It emphasizes confinement's role in mitigating volume expansion, stabilizing SEI films, and enhancing kinetics, offering systematic mechanistic insight and design guidance to accelerate commercialization of high-energy, long-cycle-life SIBs.

💡 This review uniquely consolidates advances in biodegradable supercapacitors for temporary implants, spanning materials, electrochemical performance under physiological conditions, degradation kinetics, and regulatory pathways.
